title: Lightning Is Hotter Than the Surface of the Sun
description: A bolt of lightning heats the air around it to about five times the temperature of the Sun's surface.

scenes.text: Every bolt of lightning is hotter than the surface of the Sun.
scenes.subject: lightning
scenes.say: [gasps] Every bolt of lightning is HOTTER than the surface of the Sun.

scenes.text: Lightning can heat the air around it to roughly thirty thousand degrees Celsius, in a fraction of a second.
scenes.subject: lightning
scenes.say: Lightning can heat the air around it to roughly thirty thousand degrees Celsius, in a fraction of a second.

scenes.text: The surface of the Sun is about five and a half thousand degrees. So lightning is around five times hotter.
scenes.subject: sun
scenes.say: The surface of the Sun is about five and a half thousand degrees. [excited] So lightning is around FIVE times hotter.

scenes.text: That sudden heat makes the air expand explosively. The boom you hear is thunder.
scenes.subject: lightning
scenes.say: That sudden heat makes the air expand explosively. [shouts] The BOOM you hear is thunder.

scenes.text: A tiny piece of something hotter than the Sun, right outside your window. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: lightning
scenes.say: [whispers] A tiny piece of something hotter than the Sun, right outside your window. [chuckles] Follow for more weird facts.
